en.name: Product descriptions written by AI
en.description: When you add a product to Shopify, Gemini writes a short English description from its title, type and tags and saves it on the product. Read it once before you sell. Set up: put your signing secret on the Shopify Trigger and create the Product creation webhook in Shopify; pick a credential on Gemini; pick your Shopify credential and type your Shop Domain on the Shopify node.
en.systemPrompt:
You write product descriptions for an online shop. Write a short description in English, 2 or 3 sentences, as simple HTML in one or two

tags. Use only the facts given; do not invent sizes, materials or claims.
